title: Safety, Security & Governance
summary: How AI systems fail and get attacked (prompt injection, data exposure, excessive agency) and the layered defenses that hold.
outcomes: Explain prompt injection and why it can't be filtered away
Apply least privilege, approval gates, and defense in depth
Protect personal and confidential data across prompts, logs, and outputs
Threat-model an AI system and red-team it before attackers do

lessons.title: Defense in depth for AI systems
